segmentler.metin: The Baker Test contaminated an entire fleet.
It took only an underwater atomic detonation.
So how could an underwater atomic detonation do this?
The answer is radioactive base surge and spray — and it is why underwater nuclear tests proved far dirtier than airbursts.
